name: gitignore-guard
description: Warns before node_modules, build output, OS junk or huge files get staged.

maxFileMb.title: Largest file (MB)
maxFileMb.description: Refuse to stage files bigger than this. 0 turns the size check off.

extraPatterns.title: Extra patterns
extraPatterns.description: Comma-separated globs for more files or folders that must not be staged, e.g. *.sqlite,coverage/.
